title: APRIL: Ambiguity-Aware Expert Routing for Respiratory Sound Domain-Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated respiratory sound classification enables continuous, non-invasive respiratory assessment, yet long-term deployment remains challenging due to domain shifts from evolving recording devices and acquisition periods. When privacy and governance regulations prohibit replaying historical data, sequential learning easily overwrites previously acquired knowledge. Preserving dedicated domain experts prevents parameter interference, but selecting the correct expert at inference is difficult under overlapping acoustic distributions and absent domain labels. To resolve this dilemma, we propose APRIL, an exemplar-free domain-incremental framework for RSC. Built on a shared frozen BEATs backbone, APRIL sequentially inherits and isolates low-rank experts to enable new-domain adaptation without altering earlier models. translated_title: APRIL：面向呼吸音域增量学习的歧义感知专家路由
translated_abstract: 自动呼吸音分类能够实现连续、无创的呼吸评估，然而由于录音设备和采集时段不断演变所导致的域偏移，长期部署仍然充满挑战。当隐私和治理法规禁止回放历史数据时，顺序学习极易覆盖先前习得的知识。保留专用的域专家可以防止参数干扰，但在声学分布相互重叠且缺乏域标签的情况下，推理时选择正确的专家十分困难。为解决这一困境，我们提出了APRIL，一个面向呼吸音分类的无样本域增量学习框架。APRIL构建于共享且冻结的BEATs主干之上，通过顺序继承和隔离低秩专家，在不改动早期模型的前提下实现新域适应。多级原型路由器检索出前两个候选专家，并通过整合……动态选择最终模型。
tldr: 提出APRIL框架，通过在冻结的BEATs主干上继承与隔离低秩专家，并利用歧义感知的多级原型路由器在声学分布重叠、无域标签的情况下选择正确专家，从而解决呼吸音分类中域增量学习的知识遗忘与专家选择难题。
en_tdlr: APRIL is an exemplar-free domain-incremental learning framework for respiratory sound classification that sequentially inherits and isolates low-rank experts on a frozen BEATs backbone, with an ambiguity-aware multi-level prototype router selecting the correct expert under overlapping acoustic distributions and absent domain labels.
